utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll wait for Jules to confirm the date and time, and then we can set the repair drive. Once that’s in place, Bo can bring the gloves and box cutter.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once Jules sends the final date and time, I can work around the school schedule. Then we’ll be set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — once Jules confirms it, I’ll set the repair drive and let Bo know to bring the gloves and box cutter.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll bring the box cutter, packing tape, and markers, and I can help sort the donations by size too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ve got gloves and can bring a box cutter too. What’s the exact time for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I’ll check and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oren said he’ll do his best to help sort out what’s needed for the repair drive. Rey’s bringing the details to him, and Nell’s happy to help too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can sort the donated tools and make a quick sign-up list. Pia can jump in too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — that’ll really help get the repair drive organized. I’ll let Oren and the others know Leo’s sorting the tools and making the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once I know the timing and drop-off spots. Can you get those confirmed first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes — I’ll confirm the timing and drop-off spots, then pass them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. Once you have the timing and drop-off spots, let me know and I can help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive. Just let me know the date and time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I’ll check the final date and time and send it over as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’m easy to miss updates, so just ping me when you know the date and time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — the repair drive is still on, Quinn can keep spreading the word, Gus can take a couple spots, and Pia can jump in too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that keeps it simple. Let’s keep the list open and steady, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m at the sign-up table now, sorting the donated tools and checking which ones still need labels. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I can help haul or sort if you need an extra pair of hands. Just let me know when you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great — I’m at the sign-up table now, so if you can come by, I can use an extra pair of hands sorting and labeling the tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Noah is sorting the donations and handing them out, and Quinn is helping spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but is it still on for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still on for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and inviting more neighbors. Gus is taking a couple spots, and Noah’s coming by to help sort and hand out the donations.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep collecting requests and make sure everyone knows it’s on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep inviting folks and passing along the Sunday details at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Oren — I’ve got the tools and I’m signed up for a couple spots at the repair drive. Quinn lined me up for them, so I’m set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Gus — great, that’s a big help. I’m happy to pitch in and I’ll do my best to sort out what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate that. It starts at 10 a.m., so I’ll bring the tools and be ready for my spots.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping the supply list updated for Sunday at the community center. If you hear anything about what’s still needed, let me know and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m headed to the sign-up table now, so I’ll check what’s still needed and send you the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep the list updated once you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo’s got the tools sorted and a simple sign-up list ready. Once Jules sends the final date and time, Rey can pass the repair drive details along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s helpful. I’m still sorting a few things out for the repair drive, so I’ll wait on the final date and time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Noah can help sort the donations and hand them out for the repair drive team. We’re just waiting on Jules’ final date and time so Rey can send everything along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks—I'll wait to hear from Oren about the small item, and I can bring it if needed. Good to know the repair drive is at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, 10 a.m. works for me. I’ll bring my tools and cover a couple spots there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks, Gus. I’ll keep an ear out for Oren’s note and any updates from Ira or Kira.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center. I’m collecting requests now, and Cleo’s keeping track of supplies as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — I’m happy to help sort out what’s needed. Rey said they’d bring me the details, so I’ll do my best to get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Oren — thank you. Once Rey sends the details, we’ll line everything up for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll let Quinn know Noah can sort and hand out the donations, and Sam’s got the size sorting plus the box cutter, tape, and markers. Opal’s at the sign-up table until 6, and Rey will pass along the final details once Jules sends the date and time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks—I'll keep spreading the word and invite a few more neighbors too. Great to hear Noah’s sorting donations and that Gus is taking a couple spots.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good—I’ll keep repeating the plan and let you know as soon as Jules sends the final date and time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — once we lock in the date and time, Mina can help with hauling or sorting. I can sort the donations and hand them out, too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — have you locked in the date and time yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Not yet — I still need to pin that down. Once I do, I’ll let you know so you can help with hauling or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s at the sign-up table now, so that’s the best place to head. Cleo’s keeping the supplies list current, and Leo is sorting the donated tools and sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll head to the sign-up table and bring the box cutter, packing tape, and markers. I can help sort the donations by size once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — head to the sign-up table and ask Leo where he wants the tools sorted. If you spot anything useful, pass it along and I’ll make sure it gets to the right people.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. If you can walk folks over to the sign-up table, that’d be great since you’re there until 6.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll guide people to the sign-up table and stay through 6. Quinn’s already spreading the word, and Noah’s sorting the donations so we’re covered there too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — that covers a lot. Once Rey brings the details, I can line things up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping the supplies list updated for Sunday at the community center. If you hear what’s still available, send it my way and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I will — once Jules sends the final date and time, I’ll bring you the repair drive details. Opal’s at the sign-up table until 6 too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the list ready for Sunday at the community center. Send me the final details when you get them, and I’ll update the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good — once the timing and drop-off spots are set, Cleo can send the latest list and keep the supplies updated. Noah sorting and handing out donations should help us stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, I’m still waiting on the exact time. I can bring gloves and a box cutter, and Gus said he’s got a couple spots and the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but we still need the exact time and drop-off spots before we can finalize anything. Once you have those, I’ll make sure Cleo’s list goes out and we can keep the supplies lined up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but the repair drive is at the sign-up table now. Jules, once you send the final date and time, Rey can share the full details and Faye can coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the final date and time and send it over right away. Then Rey can share the full details and Faye can coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — thanks, Jules. I’ll let Ira know there’s progress, and I’ll keep an eye on the sign-up table here until the final date and time comes through.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’ll wait for Jules’s confirmed date and time, then Bo can bring the gloves and box cutter and we can set everything up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll keep sorting the donated tools and make a quick sign-up list. Noah can take the donations and hand them out, and Pia can jump in too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works — once Jules sends the confirmed date and time, we’ll be ready to set it up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, Sunday at the community center is still on. I’m hearing Dane’s at the sign-up table by the hall entrance until 6, and I can point folks to the late-afternoon slots.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — if I need to check what supplies we still have, I should ask Cleo, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting a few things out for the repair drive, but Mara will get the donated tools sorted and flagged for any labels. Faye can help around pickup time and point volunteers toward the later afternoon jobs once the sheet is ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s good news — Oren’s happy to help sort out what’s needed, and Rey will bring him the repair drive details. Nell’s glad to help too, so we’re in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s a relief — thank you. Once the sheet’s ready, I’ll keep things moving on my end.
